A week with the Word.

A message isn’t over when the service ends. Here’s a simple rhythm for carrying it into the rest of your week.

  1. SunHear it1:30 PM, in person
  2. Mon
  3. Tue
  4. WedOnlineOn Spotify, usually by today
  5. Thu
  6. Fri
  7. Sat
  1. 01

    Return to Scripture

    Read the passage for yourself. Notice its context and what it reveals about God.

  2. 02

    Pray honestly

    Bring your questions to God. Ask Him to grow your understanding and help you respond.

  3. 03

    Walk it out

    Choose one step of obedience and share what you are learning with someone in your community.

Hear it in person.
